concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-account-invoice-settings]] — 2026-09-15 snapshot of Adyen Customer Area invoice settings for one merchant account or company-account batch edit, including legal-entity disablement and Support-only charged-account changes; invoice configuration does not establish payment or payout flow.
warnings: The page concerns Adyen invoice charges and delivery, not shopper payment funds flow, merchant-of-record identity, or payout execution.
Different merchant/company legal entities prevent disabling merchant invoices in the dated guide; it states no Customer Area user role requirement.
